reviews.text: My 19 month Frenchie was a really excitable dog. He would jump on everyone in the house and visitors. He also wanted to bite all the time. I got in touch with Kevin and he was absolutely amazing. We had around for 90 mins and told us how to calm my dog down and stop him jumping and biting. Within an hour of Kevin being here my Frenchie had already shown so much change. It's been 2 weeks and now he doesn't jump or bite. Thankyou so much to Kevin. Your visit really paid off. I would definitely recommend.

We were struggling with some new behaviour issues with our 8 month old Romanian rescue who was constantly nipping at our feet, annoying our older dog and generally not listening. After a home visit with Kevin he was like a different dog immediately! Kevin showed us how to teach him that we are in charge and gave us useful practical techniques that we’ve been able to implement straight away - and they’re working! Our older dog is already much happier too. Kevin was knowledgeable, patient and answered all our questions (I had a list!) If you’re not enjoying life with your dog right now or just want to prevent bad habits I highly recommend a session with Kevin to get you on the right track.

I can not praise Kevin highly enough. His 1-1 sessions over WhatsApp video calls have really helped to reassure me that I am doing the right things with my 10 week old puppy.
We had an hour chat before we got her and he helped us to prepare the space and explained some of the routines and situations that we needed to be ready for.
The on day 2 I needed serious help with the pee and poop situation. I had a response really quickly and  his suggestions had an immediate impact. Although we still have the odd accident it is so much better.
Then today I had a panic about settling her and leaving her in a room on her own and within hours I had had a chat with Kevin and now I can leave the room!!!
If you need quick supportive advice, he is your man!!! Thank you soo much.

Very helpful and professional dog coach. I highly recommend having a video call with Kevin if you like us wanted to get some tips and hints on how to get the best start with your new puppy when we were feeling a bit overwhelmed the first week. We got some very good guidance and are excited to start practicing! Very good value for such expertise as well.
